headline: Operating profit climbs while net profit falls
summary_short: Revenue was KRW 258.4B, up 34.8% y/y, and operating profit was KRW 116.3B, up 66% y/y, while net income fell 23.9% to KRW 54.3B.
summary_long: Quarterly operating profit topped KRW 100B for the first time, and was about 20% above a KRW 96.7B consensus per a Seoul Economy report. One brokerage cited a lower revenue figure of KRW 254.8B. Yahoo EPS was KRW 694 against KRW 947 a year ago. No drivers or guidance are assessed.
confidence_notes: primary filing unreachable — KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed. Figures come from search-result snippets of third-party coverage of preliminary results. EPS is Yahoo data.
